# FDG8008

> DO provide get-only properties for required arguments.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.2 Attributes.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1019
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

The text has no body. CA1019 treats the constructor parameters of an attribute as its required arguments and reports one that has no public property of the same name (ignoring case), one whose matching property has a getter that is not public, and one whose matching property has a public setter (probe with SDK 10.0.402). Removing a public setter changes the public API, so the fix is breaking. The SDK code fix that adds a missing property adds a get-only property that nothing assigns (probe), so it does not complete the fix either.
